caption: The drawing depicts a landscape scene with a symmetrical organization, featuring a variety of objects rendered in muted, earthy colors such as reds, greens, yellows, and blues. In the top section of the image, three buildings with red roofs are situated on a green hill surrounded by trees, with one building having a distinct barn-like appearance. A line of trees separates this upper section from the lower sections. The middle part of the drawing contains a yellow house with a red roof and two chimneys on the left, connected to a red walkway leading diagonally downward. The area in front of the house is divided into rectangular garden plots, each containing different plants or flowers, including stylized red and pink blossoms and rows of green stems and leaves. Another yellow structure with a red roof and door is on the right. Trees with green foliage and various plants fill the remaining spaces, and birds are visible in the sky above the buildings. The entire scene is bordered by a wide decorative frame with a repeating wavy pattern in yellow, black, and red, and there is an additional upper border containing floral garlands and geometric motifs on a tan background.
title: Over Mantel Picture
